featured_reviews.name: Shrungal Kulkarni
featured_reviews.review_text:
My recent student visa appointment at VFS Global's German Consulate in Mumbai was a very smooth experience, thanks to a few factors. I had booked a slot for the Premium Lounge, and if you can afford the extra cost, it's absolutely the best choice.
I arrived well before my scheduled appointment time of 12 PM, and because there was very little rush, the entire process was completed much faster than I anticipated. The efficiency of the premium lounge staff was a major factor. The lounge has a dedicated team to guide you through every single step, from document verification to biometrics.
The key benefit of the Premium Lounge is the convenience. If any documents are missing, you can print them right there without leaving the premises. This alone saves a significant amount of stress and time. They also offer services like on-site biometric photo capture, which is incredibly helpful.
While the normal queue can be fast if you're lucky and there's no rush, the premium lounge guarantees a swift and guided experience. And for the little things that make a difference, the lounge offers complimentary tea, coffee, cookies, and a section with sweets and salted chips. While it's impossible to "cover the cost" of the lounge just by eating snacks—as a friend of mine proved by eating 30 chocolates and still barely making a dent—they are a nice touch that adds to the overall convenience and comfort.
One important note for those driving: There is parking available, but it is paid and can be a downside. The cost starts at ₹300 for the first two hours. If you exceed that by even a minute, an additional ₹100 is added, which can quickly add up.
Overall, the VFS Global German Consulate in Mumbai offers a fantastic service. If you're on a tight schedule or just want peace of mind, the premium lounge is a worthwhile investment, just be mindful of the parking fees.
